title: Network Management: Main Exam, 17 December 2018
programme: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology / bachelor of Business Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B. PAGE 2 OF THE ORIGINAL SCAN IS MISSING, SO QUESTIONS MARKED [PREDICTED] WERE WRITTEN TO FILL THE GAP AND ARE NOT FROM THE PRINTED PAPER.

parts.text: Explain the difference between static and dynamic IP addresses.
Differentiate between the following terms, giving examples.
IPv4 and IPv6 addressing schemes
Guided and unguided transmission media
You are a network engineer for an organization with two hundred network users. The organization has offices located in three buildings. Answer the following questions.
Which class of private IPs will you implement?
[Predicted] Suggest a suitable network topology for each building and justify your choice.
[Predicted] Name the network devices you would use to interconnect the three buildings.
Discuss two strategies adopted to enhance the security of wireless networks.
Identify two challenges of such a network.
[Predicted] Describe the layers of the OSI model, giving one protocol or device at each layer.
[Predicted] Explain the five functional areas of network management.
[Predicted] Describe three tools used to monitor network performance.
[Predicted] Differentiate between static and dynamic routing, giving an example of a protocol for each.
[Predicted] Explain the importance of a network security policy to an organization.
[Predicted] Describe the troubleshooting steps you would follow when a user cannot connect to the network.

You finally have a consulting project you've been waiting for: a customer is building a new office and has asked you to design their entire local area network (LAN), as their present infrastructure is outdated and has ports failing by the day. As a consultant, identify factors that you need to consider when designing the physical local area network.
For the address 192.168.10.0/26 determine the following.
The subnet mask
Number of subnets
Hosts per subnet
Valid subnets
Valid hosts on each subnet
Broadcast address for each subnet
Briefly explain the meaning and use of the following applications.
DHCP
DNS
NAT
Network operating systems are said to be multi-user and multi-tasking. Differentiate these two terms.
How does a network operating system differ from a standalone operating system?
Explain how a firewall works to enforce a security policy.
You are a network administrator in an organization. How will you know that the network has been broken into? What will you do?
